notes: §2002:12.3.4.3 GR2: OPTIONAL applies to input, I-O and extend mode only; an absent OPTIONAL file opens 05 (I-O/extend create it, §2002:9.1.12.1), its first READ is 10 (§2002:9.1.12.3), an absent non-optional file is 35 (§2002:9.1.12.5), and OUTPUT on an OPTIONAL file is 00, for sequential, relative and indexed files. g2opt01 run at --std 2002 matched the derived 21 lines.
